remarks: Welcome to 98 Rowayton Woods Drive, a delightful 3 bedroom, 2 bath condominium on the first floor for easy walk out on the ground level. This home offers 1,356 square feet of comfortable living space, thoughtfully designed for modern lifestyles.  The open-plan living and dining area is perfect for both relaxing and entertaining, with large windows that fill the space with natural light. Each bedroom provides a cozy retreat, while the two spacious bathrooms add a touch of luxury.  Located in the charming Rowayton Woods community, residents enjoy access to amenities like a pool and tennis courts, as well as a community garden and walking trails, all enhancing leisure and recreation options. The convenient location is close to beaches, shops and transit access for those commuting to New York City.  This home blends comfort with convenience, making it a wonderful retreat thats all yours! Schedule a visit today to discover the inviting charm of 98 Rowayton Woods Drive. A reserved parking spot right near the unit as well as garage #24 included in the sale.
